page.overview:
What is Gimmighoul?

Gimmighoul is a tiny humanoid Pokémon with a flat shape, and a particularly round head that is large compared to its body. It has a light-grey, silvery metallic body, long, thin arms with circular paws, stubby legs, and two black stripes circling its slightly plumper waist. It has a pair of golden-yellow circular eyes that are surrounded by black markings in the shape of eyeglasses. It also has two antennae and a tail which resemble and act as modern metal dowsing rods.

In its Roaming form, Gimmighoul typically carries a single yellow coin on its back using its prehensile tail. Its tail holds the coin tightly against its body as it carefully wanders. While in its Chest form, Gimmighoul inhabits a red coin-filled chest with gold accents, a black latch, and a silver lock containing a small design with the number 1000 imprinted on it.

Shiny Gimmighoul are nearly white in color, a slightly lighter hue than the seal on their treasure chests.

Gimmighoul is able to take control of both humans and Pokémon by using its ghostly energy. Gimmighoul mostly use this ability to obtain coins that its victims manage to collect for it.
